Our Mission

Why We Do What We Do

Serving the WHOLE Person

Evolve Community exists to serve the WHOLE person — promoting wellness, restoring stability through housing, creating opportunity through mentorship and education, building life skills for long-term success, and advancing equity and justice so every individual has a fair and sustainable path to thrive.

Why We Exist

Bridging the Gap

Many individuals and families face barriers to stable housing, mentorship, financial literacy, wellness resources, and meaningful community support. These barriers often create cycles that are difficult to overcome alone.

We exist to bridge those gaps by connecting people with practical resources, trusted relationships, and opportunities that empower long-term success — not just temporary solutions.

"We don't do charity — we do partnership. We walk alongside people, not ahead of them."

Our Framework

The W.H.O.L.E. Framework

Everything we do is guided by our W.H.O.L.E. Framework — a holistic approach that addresses the interconnected needs of individuals, families, and communities. Every program and initiative falls within one or more of these focus areas.

W
🧠 W — Wellness
Wellness
Mental, Physical & Basic Needs

Supporting emotional, mental, physical, and spiritual well-being through community education, support groups, outreach, and essential resources.

H
🏡 H — Housing
Housing
Restoration & Community Repair

Helping individuals and families move toward housing stability while strengthening neighborhoods through partnerships and community engagement.

O
🚀 O — Opportunity
Opportunity
Mentorship & Future Building

Creating pathways to success through mentorship, education, leadership development, workforce readiness, and youth programming.

L
🌱 L — Legacy
Legacy
Life Skills, Stability & Stewardship

Equipping individuals with financial literacy, life skills, and practical tools that create generational stability.

E
⚖️ E — Equity & Equality
Equity & Equality
Access, Advocacy & Reintegration

Connecting underserved communities to resources, advocating for equitable opportunities, and supporting successful reintegration and long-term community engagement.

What We Do

Current Projects & Initiatives

Every program we run is intentional — designed to meet people where they are and move them toward where they could be.

🤝
Community Outreach

One of Evolve Community's very first initiatives. We created a pipeline connecting volunteers who wanted to serve with organizations already making a difference throughout Milwaukee. Today, our volunteers serve weekly by preparing meals, building relationships, maintaining community spaces, mentoring children, and participating in neighborhood improvement efforts.

Wellness Equity
  • Milwaukee Rescue Mission
  • Guest House
  • Cathedral Center
  • The Gathering
  • Hope Street
  • St. Vincent de Paul
  • Salvation Army
  • Sojourner Truth House
  • Repairs of the Breach
Serving isn't just about meeting a need — it's about building relationships.
🚌
Evolve Day

Our signature day of service. For the past three years, volunteers have filled buses with care packages containing winter clothing, hygiene products, and first aid supplies before traveling throughout Milwaukee to personally connect with and serve individuals experiencing homelessness.

Wellness Equity
Looking ahead, Evolve Day is evolving. Our next initiative will focus on neighborhoods impacted by food deserts by bringing groceries directly into communities with limited access to healthy food.
🏀
Mobbing Mentorship

A structured mentorship program helping young men develop leadership, accountability, confidence, and life skills through consistent mentoring relationships. Participants engage in meaningful discussions, leadership development, and community-building while mentors walk alongside them through real-life challenges.

Opportunity
  • Carmen High School of Science & Technology — Northwest Campus
  • Milwaukee Academy of Science
🧠
Evolving Minds

A community-centered mental and emotional wellness initiative offering workshops, conversations, and resources addressing trauma, grief, stress, and mental health through professional partnerships and supportive community.

Wellness
🙏
Recovery & Spirituality

Combines biblical teaching with practical clinical principles to help participants understand themselves, overcome unhealthy patterns, build resilience, and experience lasting transformation within a supportive community.

Wellness
💰
Evolving Finance

Helping individuals and families build financial confidence through education focused on budgeting, stewardship, credit, estate planning, investing, workforce development, and long-term wealth building.

Legacy
🏡
Single Parent Housing Initiative

Supporting single-parent families through housing stability, emergency assistance pathways, financial support resources, and partnerships designed to help families build stable futures.

Housing

Where We're Headed

Our Vision for the Future

As our community grows, so does our vision. We believe the greatest impact happens when organizations work together.

01
Mobile Grocery Outreach
Expand Evolve Day into a mobile grocery initiative serving neighborhoods affected by food deserts.
02
Strategic Partnerships
Grow partnerships with businesses, nonprofits, churches, schools, and community leaders throughout Milwaukee.
03
Youth Mentorship Scale
Expand mentorship opportunities to reach more young people across Milwaukee schools.
04
Wellness & Finance Access
Increase access to financial wellness and mental health programming across underserved communities.
05
Family Housing Support
Strengthen support for families through expanded housing and community-based initiatives.
We welcome opportunities to partner with businesses, nonprofits, churches, schools, and community leaders who share our commitment to strengthening Milwaukee.
